requirement_vague: User registration should reject full_name with exact 256 characters.
requirement_precise: Attempt to register a new user via POST /api/v1/users/signup with email 'test49@example.com', password 'validpass123', and full_name of exactly 256 characters (256 'a' characters). Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/users/signup does not reject a full_name of exactly 256 characters with a 422 validation error.
omissions.reasoning: The signup endpoint uses the UserRegister/UserCreate model, whose validate_full_name validator only raises an error when len(full_name) > 255. A 256-character full_name therefore fails validation and FastAPI returns 422, satisfying the requirement.
